import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json
p={'url':'https://arxiv.org/pdf/2006.05511','routes':['346828','377653'],'destination':'sources/independence.pdf','source_identity':'Beaton Cameron unicyclic independence polynomial well covered tree counterexamples','purpose':'Compare actual public connected counterexample theorem against both reserved independence targets'}
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'plans/get-independence.json'],input=json.dumps(p),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'source_get_guard.py'),str(Path.cwd()/'plans/get-independence.json')],check=True)
r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/independence.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'sources/independence.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
s=r.stdout;p=s.find('Conjecture');print(s[p-1600:p+1600]);p=s.rfind('well-covered');print(s[p-9000:p+1600])
